subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Meet the four members of the new WOW! Team.
Match readers' comments to magazine topics.
Introduce yourself and say what you want to read about.

tf.s: WOW! stands for World of Wonder.
tf.why: Yes, WOW! means World of Wonder.

tf.s: The new WOW! Team has four members.
tf.why: Right: Majid, Frank, Bayan and Emily.

tf.s: Bayan is a member of the new WOW! Team.
tf.why: Yes, Bayan is one of the four team members.

tf.s: Last year, the WOW! Team looked at happy homes.
tf.why: Correct, happy homes was one of last year's topics.

tf.s: Basim wants to read about animals.
tf.why: Basim needs travel information because he is going to Egypt by plane.

tf.s: Razan went to the zoo and wants to learn the names of animal parts.
tf.why: Yes, that is why she is interested in animals.

tf.s: Juma wants to read about architects because he is going on holiday.
tf.why: Juma is doing a school project about different jobs.

tf.s: “Nice to meet you” is a good way to answer an introduction.
tf.why: Yes, we say it when we meet someone new.

tf.s: “Last year, we look at happy homes” is a correct sentence.
tf.why: We use the past simple: Last year, we looked at happy homes.

tf.s: “I'm going to visit my grandparents” talks about the past.
tf.why: Going to talks about a future plan.

boxes.q: How many members are in the new WOW! Team?
boxes.why: The team is Majid, Frank, Bayan and Emily.

boxes.q: Which topic did the team look at last year?
boxes.why: Last year's topics were happy homes, different clothes and keeping safe outdoors.

boxes.q: Who is going to Egypt by plane?
boxes.why: Basim needs travel information for his trip.

boxes.q: Who uses the metro in the city?
Hello, I'm Emily. – Hi Emily, ___ to meet you.
boxes.why: We say Nice to meet you.

boxes.q: Which tense is in: I'm going to fly next summer?
boxes.why: Going to + verb shows a future plan.

boxes.q: Choose: Yesterday we ___ to the park.
boxes.why: Yesterday needs the past simple: went.

boxes.q: Which word is a magazine topic this year?
boxes.why: This year's topics include writers, animals, travel, jobs and entertainment.

boxes.q: Which expression is NOT for introducing yourself?
boxes.why: See you later is for saying goodbye.

hunt.q: Team member with an English name
Who wants to read about animals?
Who wants to read about jobs?
Topic for someone who loves planes
Topic for someone who visited a zoo

mcq.q: Who are the four members of the new WOW! Team?
mcq.why: The readers wrote comments; the team is Majid, Frank, Bayan and Emily.

mcq.q: What were the three topics of last year's magazine?
o: happy homes, different clothes, keeping safe outdoors
mcq.why: Those three topics were in the Grade 6 magazine.

mcq.q: Which two readers need information about travel?
mcq.why: Basim is flying to Egypt and Eliza uses the metro.

mcq.q: Complete: Hello! I'm Emily and I'm ___ to meet you, too.
mcq.why: We say: I'm pleased to meet you.

mcq.q: Salim loves trains. Which sentence is best for him?
o: I'd like to read about famous railways because I love trains.
I'd like to read about clowns because I love animals.
I read about trains last year because I will love them.
I like trains so I don't want to read about them.
mcq.why: Use I'd like to read about … because … with a clear reason.

o: It was raining yesterday, but today it is very hot.
It is raining yesterday, but today it was very hot.
It rains yesterday, but today it was hot.
It was raining yesterday, but today it were hot.
mcq.why: Yesterday takes the past; today takes the present.

mcq.q: Which sentence is a future plan?
o: Next summer, I'm going to go on a plane.
Last summer, I went on a plane.
I go on a plane every summer.
I went to the zoo yesterday.
mcq.why: Going to + verb tells us about a plan.

mcq.q: Why might Juma want to read about architects?
o: He is doing a school project about different jobs.
He wants to be a clown.
mcq.why: His comment says he wants to know what an architect does every day.

mcq.q: Razan went to the zoo. Which topic fits her best?
mcq.why: She wants to learn the names of parts of animals.

mcq.q: Find the mistake: Last year, we look at how to make our homes happy.
mcq.why: Last year tells us to use the past simple: looked.
